audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] and the late-game prose told the user to save Wind Wall for 'his R engage'.
audit.why: Only Thundering Shuriken (Q) carries the projectile flag. Electrical Surge (W) is an on-hit application, Lightning Rush (E) is a self-transform, and Slicing Maelstrom (R) is a zone that strikes nearby champions — none of them are projectiles, so the wall does nothing against them. Wind Wall blocks ALL projectiles for its 4s, not one per cast; the mirror audit corrected the same false mechanic on Kennen's page.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall stops Thundering Shuriken only. W, E and R go through it — which is why the three-mark stun still lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Yasuo levels 3, 4-5 and first item; the mirror gives Kennen every row from 2 through first item, with level 1 a skill test and 2+ items to Yasuo.
audit.why: Kennen's 950-range shuriken and the Mark of the Storm stun beat a melee with a 475-range Q for the whole laning phase, and his first AP item lands before Yasuo's crit curve. Yasuo's edge only arrives with two items.
audit.corrected: Rows to Skill, Kennen, Kennen, Kennen, Kennen, Kennen, Yasuo — proposed as matched full/content pairs with ratings moved to fit.

audit.whatIsWrong: First-item prose claimed the matchup flips to Yasuo there.
audit.why: The mirror puts first item with Kennen, and his first AP item spikes a magic-damage on-hit kit against a champion with no MR. Yasuo's real spike is the second item.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text, phases[5].why, whys[5] and late all moved the flip to two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention that Kennen's damage is on-hit magic and scales with attack speed.
audit.why: Electrical Surge (W) carries the onHit flag — buying armour reads the trade completely wrong against him.
audit.corrected: Added to spikes[2].text and dosFull[2].d, which sits under the existing 'Build MR' heading.

edits.before: Stack tornado through the wave; your passive shield eats one poke for free. Identify how Kennen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Stack tornado through the wave; your passive shield eats one shuriken for free. Thundering Shuriken is 7s at rank 1 — step up in that gap.

edits.before: E dashes through minions make you untouchable in the wave. Only take the trade when Kennen's Lightning Rush is down.
edits.after: Mark of the Storm stuns on the third hit and only Thundering Shuriken is a projectile — W and E go through Wind Wall.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Kennen must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but he still out-ranges you. Stack Q off minions and hold Wind Wall for the shuriken landing his third mark.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Lightning Rush's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Thundering Shuriken falls to 4.75s by rank 4 while Wind Wall is still 19s — you cannot wall every one. Dodge instead, farm safe.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Lightning Rush's cooldown.
edits.after: His first AP item lands before your crit curve does — hold under tower, take the shuriken gaps, and wait for item two.

edits.before: Kennen out-pokes you at level 1 with Q shuriken range you can't match.
edits.after: Level 1 is even: his 950-range shuriken versus your Q stacks in the wave.

edits.before: At level 2 his stacking mark passive threatens a stun that keeps him ahead.
edits.after: At level 2 Electrical Surge stacks a second mark and the stun threat is real.

edits.before: At levels 4-5 it becomes a skill check as you learn to dodge and Wind Wall his Q.
edits.after: At levels 4-5 his shuriken drops toward 4s and the mark stun still out-trades you.

edits.before: At first item Wind Wall negates his poke and your dive burst kills him.
edits.after: At first item his AP spike out-bursts you before your crit items come online.

edits.before: Your first item flips it: once you can survive the poke, Wind Wall his shuriken and E onto him — he's squishy with only E Lightning Rush to escape, and your burst kills him through it.
edits.after: His first AP item is the harder spike: Electrical Surge applies on-hit and scales with attack speed, so armour reads the trade wrong — take Mercury's Treads and MR and wait for your second item.

edits.before: Save Wind Wall for his shuriken poke or his R engage
edits.after: Save Wind Wall for the shuriken; only his Q is blockable

edits.before: By levels 4-5 it's a skill check — hold Wind Wall for his Q so his mark passive never hits three, and weave your own Q stacks off minions. At 6 his R can chain-stun in a 1v1, but respected properly the lane evens out. Don't force before your item; play the dodge game and wait for your spike.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 still favour him — hold Wind Wall for the shuriken so Mark of the Storm never hits three, and weave your own Q stacks off minions. Only Thundering Shuriken is a projectile: Electrical Surge, Lightning Rush and Slicing Maelstrom all pass through the wall. Wait for your spike.

edits.before: From first item on the matchup is yours. Wind Wall shuts down his shuriken poke and R engage, and your E-Q dive kills his squishy body through Lightning Rush. His R is a teamfight threat, but in the side lane a fed Yasuo beats him cleanly.
edits.after: From your second item on the matchup is yours. Wind Wall shuts down his shuriken poke — his W, E and Slicing Maelstrom pass straight through it, so kill him before the third mark lands. In the side lane a fed Yasuo beats him cleanly.

edits.before: Kennen wastes Lightning Rush — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Electrical Surge applies on-hit magic damage — armour reads this wrong.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Three Marks of the Storm stun you; Wind Wall only stops the Q one.

edits.before: Track Kennen's Lightning Rush: His escape. EQ-R when it’s down. When it is down — EQ-R him.
edits.after: Wind Wall blocks Thundering Shuriken only; W, E and R are not projectiles and pass through it.
